name: Scavenge Scrap
desc: Dig through the junkyard piles for usable metal.
flavor: Every piece of rust tells a story.
tips: Your bread and butter. Runs continuously until you stop it or run out of energy.

name: Odd Jobs
desc: Run small errands for the neighborhood.
flavor: Nobody asks questions about the kid from the scrapyard.
tips: Quick way to earn Creds. Takes 10 seconds to complete.

name: Heavy Lifting
desc: Move heavy debris to build physical strength.
flavor: Who needs a gym when you have tons of iron?

name: Repair Circuitry
desc: Study old mecha schematics and repair broken logic boards.

name: Drone Chasing
desc: Practice reaction time by catching small salvage drones.
flavor: Fast as a bolt, sharp as a blade.

name: Endure the Wastes
desc: Spend time in the toxic fumes and harsh conditions of the lower yards.
flavor: What doesn't melt you makes you harder.

name: Confront Scrap Thief
desc: A local kid tried to steal your scrap. What do you do?

choices.name: Let him go
choices.desc: The kid is hungry. You let him keep a small piece. [+Idealist]

choices.name: Threaten him
choices.desc: Show him that stealing from you is a death sentence. [+Pragmatic]

name: Search for Parts
desc: Search deeper into the scrapyard for valuable components.
flavor: The deeper you dig, the better the finds.
tips: Upgraded scavenging. Higher yield but costs more energy per second.

name: Delivery Run
desc: Deliver packages for a shady contact in the district.
flavor: Don't open the box. Don't ask about the box.
tips: Better pay than Odd Jobs. 15 seconds, higher Creds reward.

name: Search Neon Bazaar
desc: Venture into the black market district looking for rare schematics.
flavor: Neon lights hide dark secrets — and rare tech.
tips: 35% chance to find the rare Nanofiber Loom blueprint each run. Worth repeating!

name: Refine: Nano Infra
desc: Process raw scrap into nano-scale infrastructure material.

name: Refine: Armor Plating
desc: Forge ceramic-metal composite plating from refined materials.

name: Refine: Nanofiber Fabric
desc: Weave ultra-light nanofiber from processed nano-materials.

name: Salvage Mecha Parts
desc: Carefully disassemble wreckage to extract usable mecha components.
flavor: Patience. One wrong cut and it's all scrap.
tips: Produces Mecha Parts for restoring your father's mecha.

name: Scout Local Sector
desc: Check for aggressive drones in the area.

name: Repair Frame
desc: Perform maintenance and structural repairs on your mecha frame.
flavor: It's dirty work, but someone's got to keep this bucket of bolts together.
tips: Restores integrity to damaged parts. Each completion restores 1 integrity and full HP to all functional parts.
